title: Continuation of an emission property
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B$, and an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each of five deciders and each bit string. Suppose $a$ satisfies the emission property for a segment $S$ starting at $k$ with postcondition $P$, and suppose that whenever $k+|S|\le i$, every configuration satisfying $P$ can reach a configuration satisfying $Q$ while maintaining the register bound. Then $a$ satisfies the emission property for the same segment $S$ and starting position $k$, now with postcondition $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The emission property for $S$ from $a$ with postcondition $P$.
If $k+|S|\le i$, each configuration satisfying $P$ reaches some configuration satisfying $Q$ while maintaining the register bound.
